question: When does an approved SOP become effective, and which version do I work to until then?
expected_gist: Effective date = 14 calendar days after the approval date (6.5.1); an Approved document is not used before its effective date, work continues to the previous Effective version (6.5.6).

question: How long do we have to close an NCR?
expected_gist: Within 30 calendar days of detection, or the reason for the extension is recorded in the NCR; QA closes it (7.1.2).

question: What is the analytical flow rate and the total run time of the LC method?
expected_gist: Analytical flow 5 µL/min (two nano pumps combined); the run lasts 8 min in total from injection, of which the first 2 min are trap loading at 40 µL/min.

question: What signal-to-noise ratio must the heavy (SIS) peak of a sample well reach, and what happens if it does not?
expected_gist: S/N > 5; otherwise the result of that sample is invalid (TM-105 §7.3.4).

question: The system suitability test failed. What do I do?
expected_gist: Do not inject samples; keep the plate at 4 °C in the autosampler; raise an NCR (QMS-003-F01) under QMS-003 §6.1 within 1 working day; troubleshoot only through actions recorded in the NCR; repeat the SST; QA decides the disposition (TM-104 7.5.6-7.5.11; QMS-003 6.1).

question: A batch analysis started under TM-105 v1.0 was not finished when v2.0 became effective. Can I finish it under v1.0?
expected_gist: No: the batch is analysed again from TM-105 §7.1.1 under v2.0, because v1.0 is then Superseded and only Effective versions may be used (TM-105 v2.0 2.4.1; QMS-001 7.1.1).

question: Where do I record a manual peak integration in Skyline?
expected_gist: The permitted condition from the manual integration table is entered as the mandatory reason in the Skyline audit log (TM-105 v2.0 7.2.6). Trap: v1.0 used a separate manual integration list.

question: Can we still analyse a batch with Skyline 3.6?
expected_gist: No: TM-105 v2.0 uses Skyline v26.1; a different version only after validation (QMS-006) and a change of the SOP (QMS-005). Trap: v1.0 named Skyline 3.6.
